row: Hey Guys! My name is Dr. Lindsay Butzer and I am a small animal veterinarian, working at Clint Moore Animal Hospital in Boca Raton Florida! Join me here on my channel for all my Pet Tips, Dog Breed Guides, and Travels on everything from animal rescue to the furry family members that come into my clinic that we all love. Please share your animal experiences in the comments on my videos so other pet owners can read it! I hope to see you here often!
